{"subject":"Onboarding vCluster's new AEs and SDRs","body":"Hi Fabian,

I saw vCluster has 7 sales roles open, including Federal Account Executive and Enterprise Account Executive, plus SDRs in NYC and the SF Bay Area. Headcount is also up 17.3% in six months.

That usually means more deals than one person can review, and new reps starting without a set pipeline process. Quillpath reads your CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) every night, flags stalled deals each morning, and gives each rep a short list of next actions. It also writes a weekly forecast summary you can forward to the board.

Would you like a free 14-day pilot on your real pipeline before the new reps start? Setup takes about 15 minutes, and nothing needs to be migrated.","missing":["Which CRM vCluster uses (HubSpot or Salesforce)","Who currently runs sales or pipeline reviews at vCluster","Whether Fabian is involved in sales process decisions, since he is the CTO"]}
